featured_reviews.name: deepaksingh pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited this pharmacy seeking a past bill from the previous financial year, but was told that they couldn't provide it since it was outside of the current financial year. I then contacted their customer care, who suggested I try visiting the shop where I made the purchase. Eventually, the branch near Vimal Dairy was able to assist me with the closed year bill. This experience raises concerns about the staff's understanding of their own system or their willingness to help. While I will continue to buy groceries here, I will avoid this pharmacy for my medication needs. It's disappointing that a pharmacy cannot provide a hard copy of a bill on demand, which is a basic expectation.
